title: Al Riyadh vs Al Nassr in the Saudi Professional League
seoTitle: Al Riyadh vs Al Nassr: Saudi Pro League Preview
subtitle: The match takes place this Friday for the second round of the competition
excerpt: Al Riyadh and Al Nassr play this Friday in the Saudi Pro League with confirmed lineups and Cristiano Ronaldo's status.
author: Daniele Morais
trending: posiciones de al riyadh contra al-nassr
contentHtml:
Al Riyadh and Al Nassr take to the pitch this Friday, August 21, to play the match valid for the second round of the Saudi Pro League. The clash is stirring up searches due to details about the teams' lineups, the situation of important players, and broadcast schedules around the world.

Match Date and Times Around the World

The game between Al Riyadh and Al Nassr is scheduled for this Friday, August 21. The time varies by region, taking place at 11:00 in Peru, Colombia, and Ecuador; at 12:00 in Chile, Bolivia, and Venezuela; and at 13:00 in Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Brazil. In Mexico, the match starts at 10:00, in the United States at 9:00 and 12:00, and in Spain at 18:00.

Cristiano Ronaldo's Status and Confirmed Lineups

Cristiano Ronaldo is part of the Al Nassr delegation, but begins the duel on the bench. Al Riyadh takes the field with Milan Borjan, Sultan Al Essa, Mohammed Al Khaibari, Hussam Majrashi, Sulaiman Hazazi, Fahad Al Jayzani, Bernard Mensah, Kader, Teddy Okou, Trézeguet, and Leandro Antunes, under the command of coach Maurício Dulac. Meanwhile, Al Nassr is fielded by Ange Postecoglou with Bento, Nawaf Boushal, Abdulelah Al Amri, Íñigo Martínez, Salem Al Najdi, Abdullah Al Khaibari, Ángelo, Kingsley Coman, Joao Félix, Sadio Mané, and Abdullah Al Hamdan.

Absences and Team Background

Al Nassr faces major losses for the duel, going without the services of four players, including Mohamed Simakan and Samu Costa, in addition to Saad Al Nasser and Mohamed Maran. However, the team seeks to overcome the injury crisis, and recent history points to an advantage for the visitor, as Al Nassr has won the last three recorded encounters between them.

Where to Watch Live

The broadcast of the game varies according to the country. In Brazil, the clash is shown on SporTV 2 and GloboPlay. In the rest of South America there is no broadcast, while in Mexico the exhibition takes place via Tubi and FOX One. In the United States, the broadcast channels include FOX Deportes, FOX Soccer Plus, FOX One, and fuboTV, and in Spain the game is available on Movistar Liga de Campeones, Movistar+, and Vamos 2.

With information from Bolavip Perú, YSscores.
